subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should OpenClaw accept a Gateway/provider-backed editable dictation workflow in the core Control UI composer now, or defer it under the broader WebChat voice/STT direction?
rationale: The issue is not a broken existing contract; it adds a browser microphone and authenticated Gateway audio path with provider/security implications, and an open closing PR is already carrying the implementation choice.

options.title: Review linked Gateway-backed PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the canonical implementation candidate and require proof/security/UI review before landing.

options.title: Defer to broader voice work
options.body: Keep the concept under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 until maintainers decide the full WebChat STT/TTS product boundary.

options.title: Reject core composer dictation
options.body: Close the linked implementation path and leave users on Talk, attachments, OS/browser dictation, or future plugin/API work.

recommendation.title: Review linked Gateway-backed PR
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 as the canonical implementation candidate and require proof/security/UI review before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is prior server-side dictation work plus current ownership of the relevant chat composer and audio transcription paths.
